instruction: In VLC's preferences, change the media recording folder to your Desktop.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (get_vlc_config) correctly reads ~/.config/vlc/vlcrc on Linux, which is the right config file for VLC settings.
Postconfig kills VLC before evaluation, forcing the process to flush its in-memory config to disk — this is essential for reading the updated setting.
Metric (is_vlc_recordings_folder) correctly identifies the 'input-record-path' key in vlcrc, skips comment lines (lines starting with '#'), and extracts the value with split+strip.
Expected value '/home/user/Desktop' is semantically correct for the Desktop directory of the 'user' account on this Linux environment.
Parameter handling is correct: expected.type='rule' causes the framework to pass the rules dict directly as the 'rule' arg; the metric accesses rule['recording_file_path'] which resolves correctly.
Negative control resistance is maintained: the default vlcrc has 'input-record-path' commented out, so the initial state returns 0.
Instruction has exactly one requirement (recording folder = Desktop) and the evaluator checks exactly that one requirement — complete coverage.

metadata.explanation: Task asks user to change VLC's recording folder path to /home/user/Desktop via Tools > Preferences. Evaluator kills VLC (to force config save), then reads ~/.config/vlc/vlcrc and checks that input-record-path equals '/home/user/Desktop'. Initial state does not have this set, so negative control resistance is maintained.
